title: 第2014章 是为黄雀第2013章 黑罗遇险
slug: 灵源仙途我养的灵兽太懂感恩了
content_zh:
第2014章是为黄雀
万千河流蜿蜒而生，好似一条条玄奥的道纹。
只转瞬间，便将周围虚空团团围住，好似一盏雕刻着万千纹路的琉璃罩罩下，堵死一切方向与退路。
那正驾风而行的黑罗仙界，骤然一停，只觉周围粘稠无比，再难移动。
“何方宵小，胆敢阻拦我黑罗仙界！”
黑罗真仙惊疑不定的漆黑眸子自界膜内升起，亮起一层幽深的灵光，随着神识细细铺开，打量着周围虚空，“古冥，古冥，既有胆拦路，为何不敢现身？！”
它不确定是不是古冥真仙！
按理来说，不应该来的那么快才是，但——不是古冥真仙又能是谁？！
“别试探了！”
虚空中有灵光凝形，一只万丈炎龙凝形而出，“什么古冥不古冥的，本仙行不更名，坐不改姓，赤元真仙是也！”
而在另一侧，一只银色云雕也自虚空裂隙中施施然地落下，“听起来，你这孽畜是招惹上了强敌，这才举界而逃的？！”
听到这话，黑罗真仙的一颗心沉到了谷底。
好消息，并非是古冥真仙追了上来。
坏消息，有两只真仙后期大妖联手围杀，并且已经布下天罗地网，不将其击溃，黑罗仙界绝难脱身！
怎会如此倒霉？！
“古冥真仙？”
赤元真仙喃喃一声，有些疑惑，也有些兴奋，“或许，此番，还能买一送一？”
说话间，它的目光已经看向银雕真仙。
银雕真仙沉吟片刻，微微颔首，“也可，正好为了捕捉此界涟漪，游天丝已经耗尽，本就打算将其伐下便返程的，干脆做一笔大的。”
“那便静待鱼儿上钩吧。”

赤元真仙龙眸中闪过一抹狰狞笑意，再度看向那黑罗仙界，“不过保险起见，还是先将里面的黑羊妖打死再说，免得到时候徒增变数。”
“正是此理！”
银雕真仙自然不会反对，颔首微笑，“既能追杀的这孽畜夺界而逃，想来实力不弱，还是尽量降低些风险的好。”
见那一龙一雕旁若无人，竟在自己面前扬此妄言，黑罗真仙大为震怒，“好两只孽畜，竟敢在此大言不惭，说到底也不过是同为真仙后期，纵使以一敌二，但我界在此，岂容尔等如此嚣张。”
话音方落，黑罗仙界的界膜上亮起千星，勾连成一道道阵纹，聚于一点，显化神瞳。
漆黑神瞳注视，荡开层层漆黑波动。
赤元真仙和银雕真仙也不禁为之神魂一荡，但旋即回神过来，联手打落那紧随而至的黑色矛雨，将此一波攻势击溃！
“有点门道！”
赤元真仙万丈龙躯燃起熊熊烈火，将周围虚空烧的焦黑，狰狞咆哮，“但越是如此，毁灭了你我就越兴奋，我天龙仙界的血仇，唯有用血来偿还！”
你天龙仙界的血仇，你去找那三座七阶极品仙界算去啊！
算在我的身上，又是什么道理！
黑罗真仙心中暗骂一声，面色阴沉如水，“既如此，那便做过一场，看究竟是谁能笑到最后！”
第2014章是为黄雀

Chapter 2014 is for the oriole
Thousands of rivers meander like mysterious lines.
In just an instant, the surrounding void was surrounded, like a glass cover engraved with thousands of patterns, blocking all directions and escape routes.
The Black Luo Immortal Realm that was riding on the wind suddenly stopped, feeling that the surroundings were extremely sticky, making it difficult to move.
"How dare you, Fang Xiaoxiao, to block our Heiluo Immortal Realm!"
True Immortal Heiluo's doubtful dark eyes rose from the boundary membrane, lighting up a layer of deep spiritual light. As his spiritual consciousness spread out, he looked at the surrounding void, "Gu Ming, Gu Ming, if you have the guts to block the way, why don't you dare to show up?!"
It’s not sure if it’s the True Immortal Gu Ming!
Logically speaking, it shouldn't have come so quickly, but - who else could it be if it wasn't the True Immortal Gu Ming? !
"Stop testing!"
There was a spiritual light condensing in the void, and a ten-thousand-foot-long flame dragon came out, "There is no such thing as ancient Ming and Gu Ming. I will not change my name when I am walking, and I will not change my surname when I am sitting. I am the True Immortal Chi Yuan!"
On the other side, a silver cloud eagle also fell from the crack in the void. "It sounds like you, an evil beast, have provoked a powerful enemy, so you ran away?!"
Hearing this, True Immortal Heiluo's heart sank to the bottom.
The good news is that it is not the Immortal Gu Ming who is chasing after him.
Bad news, there are two great demons in the late stage of True Immortal who have joined forces to surround and kill them, and they have set up a dragnet. Unless they are defeated, it will be impossible to escape from the Black Luo Immortal Realm!
How could it be so unlucky? !
"True Immortal Gu Ming?"
Immortal Chi Yuan murmured, a little confused, but also a little excited, "Perhaps, this time, we can buy one get one free?"
While speaking, its eyes were already looking at the Silver Eagle True Immortal.
The Immortal Silver Eagle pondered for a moment and nodded slightly, "Also, just in order to capture the ripples in this world, You Tiansi has been exhausted. I originally planned to cut it down and return, so I might as well make a big deal."
"Then just wait for the fish to take the bait."
A ferocious smile flashed in the eyes of Chi Yuan True Immortal Dragon, and he looked at the Black Luo Immortal Realm again, "But to be on the safe side, it is better to kill the black sheep demon inside first, so as not to increase the risk later."
"Exactly this!"
Naturally, the Silver Eagle True Immortal would not object. He nodded and smiled, "Since this evil beast can escape from the world and is not weak in strength, it is better to reduce the risk as much as possible."
Seeing that the dragon and the eagle acted like there was no one around, and actually made such false claims in front of him, True Immortal Black Luo was furious, "What two evil beasts, how dare you talk so shamelessly here. In the final analysis, they are just late-stage True Immortals. Even if we are one against two, how can we allow you to be so arrogant in this world?"
As soon as he finished speaking, thousands of stars lit up on the boundary membrane of the Black Luo Immortal Realm, connecting into formations, gathering at one point, and manifesting the divine pupils.
The dark divine pupils gazed, causing layers of dark fluctuations.
True Immortal Chi Yuan and True Immortal Silver Eagle couldn't help but feel dazed by it, but they quickly came back to their senses and joined forces to knock down the rain of black spears that followed, defeating this wave of offensive!
"Some tricks!"
Chi Yuan Zhenxian's dragon body ignited blazing fire, burning the surrounding void to black, and roared ferociously, "But the more this happens, the more excited I am to destroy you. My blood feud in the Tianlong Immortal Realm can only be repaid with blood!"
For your blood feud in the Tianlong Immortal Realm, go find those three seventh-level top-grade immortal realms to settle the matter!
What’s the point of counting it on me!
True Immortal Black Luo cursed in his heart, his face gloomy as water, "In that case, let's do it to see who can have the last laugh!"
Chapter 2014 is for the oriole
